rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 2.58 ha polygon, Halmstad; no overlap with completed fellings (0%), so not already felled.

One eligible species (EN moss Syntrichia laevipila, threats include lack of old/large trees and changed stand structure) recorded 720 m from the polygon in 2016, uncertainty 25 m; none eligible within 250 m. This gives the rubric's MEDIUM.
Within 250 m only Fraxinus excelsior (EN) was recorded (156 m, 2023); it is not flagged felling-relevant, so not eligible.

Overall effort is at the top of the county sample (2295 records, 100th percentile, above median 98). Near-site: 0 records inside the polygon and 3 records within 250 m, with 41 coarse records excluded within 250 m.

Site-bound NT fungus Xylobolus frustulatus at 410 m (2022); only 1 site-bound forest NT species is on record within 1000 m, so the 3-species NT trigger is not met. Other felling-relevant threatened records are mobile birds, which are supporting evidence only.

uncertainties: The moss record is 10 years old and 720 m away; it may not reflect the current stand.
No records inside the polygon, and only 0 inside plus 3 within 250 m. Many coarse-coordinate records were excluded, so near-site coverage is limited.
Forest type is given only as 'Normal skog'; the tools do not describe the stand.
not_established: Whether any threatened species occupies the felling site.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not show absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should inspect the stand and nearby older broadleaf trees (the moss is epiphytic) and look at the 2016 moss record location before felling. Consider a field check at the site.
